newsitem.title: UK: UK monetary meeting ends after less than one hour.
newsitem.headline: UK monetary meeting ends after less than one hour.

text.p: The monthly monetary meeting between Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George ended at about 1400 GMT, official sources said.
The meeting began shortly after 1300 GMT, lasting for nearly an hour.
Any change in monetary policy would probably be signalled by the Bank of England in money market operations early on Tuesday.
A Reuter poll of 20 UK-based economists found not one expecting any change in official rates this month. Base rates stand at 5.75 percent.
